title: Name the Code
goal: Turn a status code into a word. Anything unlisted is "other".
hints: An arm produces a value, so it takes no semicolon.
Listing 500 only handles 500. What handles everything else?
explanation: Each arm's body is an expression, so `"missing";` turns it into a statement worth `()` and breaks the match's type. Bare `missing` is an unknown variable. For the last arm, `_` is the catch-all that makes the match exhaustive. Listing `500` covers only that one code and leaves the rest unhandled, which the compiler rejects. Naming it `code` also works as a catch-all binding, so it passes too.
